construct: IgG1/IgG3 autoantibodies against postsynaptic nicotinic acetylcholine receptors can functionally block receptors, accelerate receptor internalization, and activate complement, reducing functional receptor density and damaging the postsynaptic membrane.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Fluctuating fatigable ocular/bulbar weakness with normal reflexes and AChR antibodies identifies postsynaptic myasthenia gravis; AChR antibodies block/internalize receptors and activate complement at the motor endplate.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: LEMS is presynaptic P/Q-channel disease with hyporeflexia/facilitation; botulism is toxin-mediated release failure; ALS and dystrophin disease are not AChR-antibody postsynaptic disorders.
